course.about: Team Bull Trading is a day and swing trading education community founded by Jdun, who has 9 years of trading experience, alongside a team of 10+ traders. Members join an active trading floor with live screen-share sessions, session replays, guest speakers and a weekly curriculum, trading everything from penny stocks to large-cap options.

_notes.source: Founder (Jdun, 9 years' experience) and curriculum confirmed via WebSearch of multiple independent review sites. 'website' points to the Whop store rather than teambulltrading.com - that domain's own Trustpilot profile states the company's website has closed, so we're not linking something that may be dead; it still shows 155 historical reviews but no current aggregate score, hence trustpilot is null here rather than guessed. 30% affiliate commission confirmed via whoptrends.com during our earlier shortlist research. The person gave two identical links for 'monthly' and 'annual' billing, so both pricing tiers point to the same URL (same checkout page, different billing option selected there); the annual price itself isn't shown publicly so we didn't guess it. Logo cropped from the community's own Whop banner (the bull-head mark).
